hpo.hero.title: {accent}, the governance & profit-sharing token of Hipo
hpo.hero.lead: Be part of the future of GRAM staking. Hold HPO for profit sharing and governance in the Hipo protocol.
hpo.utility.title: HPO utility
hpo.utility.profit.title: Earn profit shares
hpo.utility.profit.body: Receive a share of Hipo's protocol revenue, calculated after every validation round and paid out each Hipo Club season.
hpo.utility.earn.title: Earn HPO by staking
hpo.utility.earn.body: Hold hGRAM and earn HPO after every validation round through Hipo Club.
hpo.utility.level.title: Keep your Club level
hpo.utility.level.body: Holding your rewarded HPO keeps your Hipo Club level (selling resets you to Level 1), and a higher level earns more HPO each round; levels rise through Club activity.
hpo.utility.vote.title: Vote on key decisions
hpo.utility.vote.body: Shape the future of Hipo by voting on upgrades, strategies, and key decisions.
hpo.buy.title: How to buy HPO
hpo.buy.step2.text: Ensure you have enough GRAM for your desired HPO purchase.
hpo.buy.step3.text: Head to your favorite DEX or aggregator — STON.fi, DeDust, TONCO, GroypFi, or swap.coffee — and connect your TON wallet.
hpo.buy.step4.text: Swap your GRAM for HPO. The rate comes from the pool, so check the price impact before you confirm.
hpo.tokenomics.title: Tokenomics
hpo.tokenomics.body: Each category in HPO tokenomics is strategically designed to fuel Hipo's growth.
hpo.scarcity.title: HPO is built to get scarcer
hpo.scarcity.subtitle: A fixed supply with real burns behind it — not promises.
hpo.scarcity.fixed.title: Fixed supply
hpo.scarcity.fixed.body: 1,000,000,000 HPO, minted once. There is no inflation — burns only move the supply down.
hpo.scarcity.team.title: Team tokens burned
hpo.scarcity.team.body: 90% of the team tokens due in the first release year were burned, and the remaining release was extended from 24 to 48 months.
hpo.scarcity.seasonal.title: Seasonal burns (Seasons 1–3)
hpo.scarcity.seasonal.body: Part of the unclaimed rewards of Hipo Club Seasons 1–3 was burned (20% in Season 3) and the rest returned to the treasury. Since Season 4, HPO rewards accrue directly to hGRAM holders, so there is no seasonal claim window and no leftover pool to burn.
hpo.scarcity.held.title: Held, not flipped
hpo.scarcity.held.body: Selling rewarded HPO resets a member's Hipo Club level, so rewards flow to long-term holders.
hpo.scarcity.details: The details live in the {tokenomicsLink} and the {clubLink}.
hpo.investors.title: A unique opportunity for early investors
hpo.investors.subtitle: Proven, live on mainnet since October 30, 2023 — not just a plan.

hpo.investors.growth.early: Liquid staking on TON is still early — most stakable GRAM has yet to go liquid.
hpo.investors.growth.fundraising: No private fundraising — HPO launched publicly through an ILO, open to anyone with a TON wallet.

hpo.cta.body: We see incredible growth potential and are excited to capture that value alongside the whole Hipo community. Shape GRAM's future with HPO.
